correctness.rationale: The quintic discriminant complement exactly characterizes smooth genus-five models. Direct coefficient extraction gives the stated 5x5 Cartier/Hasse–Witt matrix; its 3x2 and 2x3 blocks have rank two throughout the smooth locus. The cohomological Frobenius transpose gives the twisted two-step matrix D=B^T(C^T)^(3) with det T, and its rank-one image when T=0 has second-iterate scalar E. The stable-rank argument yields f3=4,2,0 and a=1. Gauss primitivity and nonzero partial derivatives prove the locus geometry. Exact symbolic identities and full F3/F9 enumeration independently corroborate the proof; the infinite assertion rests on symbolic algebra, not enumeration.

value.rationale: The full natural three-parameter family of odd genus-five hyperelliptic covers has constant a-number one, yet exhibits all three even 3-ranks 4,2,0. The exact smooth irreducible first rank-drop divisor and its transverse nonempty rank-zero curve explain a genuine arithmetic-geometric degeneration not supplied by pointwise or binomial computations. The value resides in this complete geometric stratification, not in the standard matrix-extraction method.
